race.comment: URBAN LAD (17) gets the after a strong return at Eagle Farm, where he was beaten just under a length by a fitter one. He goes well here and with that run under his belt he looks the one to beat. ECO FORCE (14) returns and makes for the Matty Dunn camp with two trials behind her and brings consistent Victorian form around some better ones. Well placed to make a bright start in the new colours. CERTIFIED COPY (1) is another of the main dangers off his determined Gold Coast win, with the 3kg claim helping him carry the big weight. CUSTO (8) has been fourth in two recent Doomben runs, and gets Lerena back aboard. Has enough substance to keep the top few honest.
